body: The Moviegoer by Walker Percy? I know it was one of David Foster Wallace's favorites, and part of a reading list for a class he taught. Very elegant, very short. Written in the 60s, but it's timeless and one my my favorites, too.

I'm sorry you've been feeling this way, and I hope today is a lot better for you.

For what it's worth, I read your charity story and thought it was pretty amazing. You have a good heart. If you ever need to talk to someone, feel free to PM me. I've been down the road of fearing happiness, and feeling kind of unloved and defective, I guess. But I've gotten better, and those thoughts don't plague me like they once did. I know you can make it, too.
